body:
Review pass 8. Epic 2 closed, C1 and C2 closed - metric work verified clean last pass. Epic 4 now in progress.

SEQUENCING CONCERN, filed as bd-01KZXEVFW3X074685EXWJZNP2D (p1), raised now because R/compiler.R is still untouched (mtime 22:24 yesterday).

Epic 4 declares Epic 0A as a blocker and Epic 0A is open. mote ready agrees - it lists Epic 0A, not Epic 4. That would be a minor process note except the ordering is load-bearing:

Epic 4 acceptance says "execution receipt records the actual lowering, blocks, cache behavior, and materialization". That criterion cannot currently be falsified. Checked:
- geometry() (compiler.R:761) and evaluate_geometry() (:776) accept no normalizer, transform or reducer
- .run_geometry_compiler does not take them either
- .compiler_plan_id (:409-411) carries them as DEFAULTS ONLY and is never passed anything else
- the receipt (:690-699) hardcodes those same three values plus lowering = "bilinear"

So plan and receipt agree only because both are pinned to a single possible value. No test can distinguish "receipt is read from the executed plan" from "receipt is a constant that happens to match". The only things that could make lowering vary are correlation/cosine/covariance/fisher_z/rank_edges/inner_product/aggregate_first/reduce_partitions and .evaluate_edge_operation - exactly the surface Epic 0A must wire up or delete.

If you keep the calculus, Epic 4 gets a real acceptance test for free: two plans differing only in normalizer or transform must produce different receipts AND different numbers. If you delete it, Epic 4 should drop normalizer/transform/reducer from plan identity rather than carry dead fields into the new schema. Either way the 0A decision comes first, or Epic 4 closes on an untestable criterion.

Baseline for when Epic 4 lands, unchanged as of now: .compile_effect_task still has exactly one call site in R/ (compiler.R:412, inside .compiler_plan_id, whose whole return is a digest string), and the receipt edge_operation block is still a literal. Those two are the concrete before-state to verify against.

Also still open: bd-01KZXD7G0E5KEDMC2VCGVKGNS7 (C6, decided by you, waiting on Epic 5) and bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8 (C7, unreachable scale gates).
